meta.name: 90s Throwback
meta.description:
The coolest decade in film history now has it’s own dedicated channel on Pluto TV. Pump up your sneakers and strap on your fanny pack for your favorite blockbuster hits and indie darlings, 24 hours a day.

Shows: Virtuosity, Mary Shelley's Frankenstein, The Faculty, Sleepy Hollow, Pulp Fiction
